name: Maja Ruznic

notes.name: Wikipedia · Maja Ruznic
notes.q: Ruznic has had solo exhibitions at the Harwood Museum of Art (2021) and Tamarind Institute (2022), and at galleries including Karma (New York), Conduit Gallery (Dallas), Contemporary Fine Arts (Berlin) and Jack Fischer Gallery (San Francisco).

notes.name: Wikipedia · Maja Ruznic
notes.q: Her painting exhibition, "My Noiseless Entourage" (2020), featured aqueous figurative groupings that ranged in expression from suffering—as in The Wailer (2019), likened by a reviewer to Picasso's Guernica)—to the suggestion of interdependence and healing (e.g., Truth Seekers and In Search of New Hope, 2019).

src.name: Wikipedia · Maja Ruznic
src.q: After living in Los Angeles, she moved to the desert area of Roswell, New Mexico in 2019 and currently lives with her husband, artist Æmen Ededéen (formerly Joshua Hagler), in Placitas, NM.
